bio.text: Michael Masuda is the Democratic candidate for California's 5th Congressional District in 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Green Bay, Wisconsin; he graduated from Amador High School and earned a graduate degree from California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo, in 2013.
According to his Ballotpedia candidate survey response, he grew up in Amador County and worked as an engineer designing tools for the military and later at the U.S. State Department.
